title: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Consequence of Patient-Intrinsic or -Extrinsic Factors?
abstract_supported_note: pembrolizumab: Explicit treatment of the PML patient; worsening continued despite treatment. This is a single uncontrolled case with severe underlying immune dysfunction. It shows no benefit in that case but does not prove pembrolizumab caused deterioration, define class-wide inefficacy, or establish effects in BUB1B-associated disease.
follow_up: If used to constrain an immune-checkpoint route, recover dose, timing, immune trajectory and other treatments; do not transfer the case outcome to all PD-1 agents.

title: Aldosterone promotes cardiac endothelial cell proliferation in vivo.
abstract_supported_note: eplerenone: Pharmacological mineralocorticoid-receptor blockade inhibited endothelial proliferation in the transverse-aortic-constriction model. The abstract does not provide eplerenone dose, timing, magnitude or cardiac-performance outcomes. Reduced endothelial proliferation is a directional cellular result, not demonstrated heart-failure rescue or evidence for benefit in muscle or BUB1B-associated disease. The seven-day exposure explicitly describes aldosterone, not eplerenone.
follow_up: Resolve the eplerenone dose/timing, species, endothelial endpoint, vascular remodeling and cardiac function before deciding whether proliferation suppression is useful or harmful.
